provenance: Hand-listed NOAA NDBC buoys for the nearshore judge where CDIP has no live station in the pair table. Each buoy is paired with its OWN cell (nearest spots are 20-40 km away, outside the 10 km CDIP rule). 42035: NDBC station page (29.235 N 94.410 W, water depth 15.5 m), Galveston shelf (166 km), realtime2 WVHT live 2026-09-28. 42098: NDBC station page 'Egmont Channel Entrance, FL (214)', Scripps Waverider (CDIP 214), 27.590 N 82.931 W, water depth 14 m, West Florida shelf (185 km at the cell), realtime2 WVHT live 2026-09-28 -- added because #146's largest height increases (x2.1-2.25 at Fort Myers/Sanibel/Naples) sit on this shelf and nothing graded it. See services/weather_pipeline/ndbc_nearshore.py.
